annotations.title: See and acknowledge template category changes

description: Meta sometimes moves a template to another category, which changes its price. action list returns every such change nobody has acknowledged; action acknowledge marks one as seen for the whole workspace. Nothing is sent to Meta.

action.description: list for the category changes Meta made that nobody has acknowledged; acknowledge for one of them, named by id, which then leaves the list for the whole workspace.

id.description: The category change to acknowledge, from the list.

name: template_category_changes
title: See and acknowledge template category changes
